text: Design a high-performance n-i-p perovskite solar cell with a target PCE above 25%. I have not yet selected the HTL or ETL. Constraints: perovskite bandgap around 1.55 eV, HTL work function in the range 5.1-5.3 eV, ETL work function in the range 4.0-4.3 eV, high electron and hole mobilities, and good energetic alignment with the perovskite. Please propose suitable HTL/ETL materials and a complete device architecture that satisfies these constraints. Use the literature to justify the material choices, retrieve relevant material properties, predict the expected PCE, and identify which design parameters are most important for further improvement.
